## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Running `make test` produces **0 warnings** (currently 2 `DeprecationWarning` from `pty.fork()`)
- [ ] The warning suppression is **test-scoped only** — achieved via one of:
  - A `filterwarnings` entry in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` matching the `DeprecationWarning` message from `pty` (e.g., `ignore:.*use of forkpty.*:DeprecationWarning`)
  - Or `@pytest.mark.filterwarnings("ignore:...")` decorators on the specific spawn tests in `tests/test_terminals.py`
- [ ] The existing spawn implementation in `src/decafclaw/terminals.py` is **unchanged** — no `warnings.catch_warnings()` or other runtime suppression added to production code
- [ ] The comment at `terminals.py:71-73` documenting the deliberate fork decision remains intact
- [ ] `make test` still exercises the real PTY spawn path (no mocking introduced to avoid the warning)
